meta.title: Livewrapped Analytics: cleanup analytics cache
meta.body_summary: robot found a memory leak in the livewrapped auction cache

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent identified a possible memory leak via pattern recognition; maintainer accepted the fix after manual verification and comparison with other modules, indicating that even simple fixes may require human validation of the agent's reasoning.

detection_detail.code_reading: jefftmahoney manually inspected the code, compared cache management in other analytics adapters, and confirmed the fix was reasonable despite no benchmarking.
